text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning. First, time management is essential: create a schedule and set aside enough time for each task. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you don't waste energy on small things. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish; if a task is too big, break it into smaller parts. Finally, communication matters. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until the last minute. By combining these four skills, you can meet deadlines with less stress and produce better results.
